newsitem.title: USA: Washington Mutual files for securities.
newsitem.headline: Washington Mutual files for securities.

text.p: A business trust formed by Washington Mutual Inc filed Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to up to $300 million in subordinated capital income securities.
The trust, known as Washington Mutual Capital I, will use the proceeds from the offering to invest in junior subordinated debentures of Washington Mutual Inc.
The company intends to use the proceeds for general corporate purposes.
The offering will be made through Lehman Brothers, Chase Securities Inc, Salomon Brothers Inc and UBS Securities, the Seattle, Wash.,-based company said in the filing.
The securities have a liquidation amount of $1,000 per capital security, the filing said.
